evidence.reason: `render_units` collects every file under `systemd/` recursively and then writes each rendered template to `output / source.name` without checking output-name uniqueness. Two different source paths with the same basename (for example a nested `extra/crq-repair.service`) collapse to one target, so the later write silently overwrites the earlier unit; the returned path list also contains the same path twice, so later verification cannot recover the lost unit. Rejecting duplicate basenames before creating output files is a minimal correctness fix.
